Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifier and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against human Cytochrome P450 2C19. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join assays on assay_id, join target_dictionary on tid, and join compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN. Filter target_dictionary.pref_name to 'Cytochrome P450 2C19' and target_dictionary.organism to 'Homo sapiens'. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
